entries.d279e59a63c60570: The 11th Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal years ended June 2025 to June 2027) takes as its theme “Seeing waves of social change as opportunities for new growth,” and says that while strengthening existing businesses, it will carry out three core policies: “Expansion into service business,” “Expansion in lifestyle fields,” and “Strengthening overseas business.” Under service business expansion, it says it will move TEPLABO, an online printing service launched in May 2026, into full-scale operation.

entries.eb900865b6f66332: The company’s management philosophy calls for developing original products. It plans everything itself, from electronic products such as TEPRA to stationery such as files, and has a structure in which file manufacturing is carried out by subsidiaries in Indonesia and Vietnam, and binding fasteners for files are manufactured by a subsidiary in Malaysia. In addition to stationery and office supplies, a further feature is its lifestyle goods business, run by a group of subsidiaries that handle furniture, miscellaneous goods and others.
